summary:
Main
The week opened with a ceasefire and closed without one, which by now qualifies as continuity. On Monday, President Trump said theUnited States had halted strikes at Iran's request while warning that attacks would resume without a new deal. By Wednesday, Tehran had struck American assets across the region and Washington had answered with strikes on dozens of Iranian military targets.
